show.description: After hiring a seemingly ordinary bartender to pose as her "rented husband" to escape a predatory business merger, a struggling CEO discovers her fake spouse is actually the reclusive "Ocean King"—a billionaire tycoon who begins secretly using his vast empire to dismantle her enemies and turn their contract into a reality.
